Definition: from G2095 and G5409; to bear well, i.e. be fertile:--bring forth abundantly.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, euphoréō is the word for bring forth abundantly. In Luke 12:16, the text says "The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully."
TheologicalSignificance: In euphoréō I find no hidden theology; it simply means bring forth abundantly.
